name: custom-new-tab
description: Chrome extension; no dependencies, package.json only holds the packaging script

scripts.pack: git diff --quiet HEAD || { echo 'Uncommitted changes: commit first, the archive is built from HEAD'; exit 1; }; mkdir -p ignore && git archive -o ignore/newtab.zip HEAD manifest.json newtab.html newtab.css js icons && unzip -l ignore/newtab.zip
